exposure.needed: which external tooling (log-based alerts, dashboards, parsers) matches specific cert-manager log strings

consequence.statement: Log output that previously consisted of unstructured messages is now emitted as structured logs; cert-manager itself keeps working, but any setup matching on specific log strings could break.
consequence.remediation: Review anything that matches specific cert-manager log strings (alerts, dashboards, log parsers) and update it for the new structured log format.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 replaces previously unstructured log messages with structured logs, which could break setups that match on specific log strings.
